comments.value:
Having a parameter in the VRC_PortalMarker to pick the world's accessibility state would certainly be beneficial.

I can't find any reasons not to implement this, except maybe the fact that implementing things takes work, but that applies to all new features. So while it may take its time, I expect this to be at least accepted to be worked on at some point in the future.
I would love to be able to specify a instance ID too
@{58c6b8ad227a56787575ebbd|full_name}: Same an instance ID will be able to link the same map to have multiple instances for an event!

author.name: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance

comments.value: Scout - VRChat Head of Quality Assurance is this still being worked on at all?  I'd have thought it'd be as simple as exposing a means to select the instance type in the existing payload for portal generation, given we can manually make Portals for Invite/Friends/etc instances already.
